rationale.approved: 2026-11-06 direct user adoption: slum=贫区, mastik=胶ᴹ, ekspektor=咳出, kokle=耳螺. slum keeps poor urban district imagery with shared 区. mastik shares 胶 for resin, binding and putty/filler; its detailed meanings and short annotations remain unchanged. ekspektor describes coughing and expulsion, retaining mucus/phlegm in original annotation. kokle shares 螺 with helik (PIV sense 2 equals kokleo), keeps ear/spiral features, and the user explicitly accepts the four-stroke increase. Remove exclusive 窟,腻,痰,蜗; 78 to 59 total body strokes. Existing generator yields mastik identifier m (ᴹ); no existing bare-owner transfer, outside identifier changes, or new characters. Original detailed glosses, JA/ZH/KO annotations, root decomposition and fixed legacy unchanged. Only pre-review legacy plus evolving current; no intermediate editions or obsolete aliases.

migration_notice: Only current slum, mastik, ekspektor and kokle change. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
